content.title: Compare publishing packages and seat availability
content.description: An author reviews the publishing packages on `/publish` and on each package detail page to compare package names, taglines, prices, turnaround times, features, package codes, and remaining onboarding seats from the shared monthly pool; the flow distinguishes available packages from fully booked ones, exposes the exact capacity messaging, and returns a 404 when a nonexistent package is requested.
content.summary: Compare packages and current seat availability.
content.value: Helps authors choose the right paid publishing package before scarce onboarding seats are claimed.
criteria: `/publish` lists exactly four named packages with fixed package pricing and turnaround values.
The monthly seat pool is shared globally, with Starter at 6 seats, Standard at 4, Premium at 2, and Author's Choice at exactly 1.
Each package card lists that package’s features.
Seat-availability messaging uses `<n> seats left this month`, with the singular form `1 seat left this month` when exactly one remains.
Available packages offer `Choose <package name>`, while fully booked packages show `Fully booked this month` and offer `View details` instead.
Opening a package shows its code (`FP-PKG-01` … `FP-PKG-04`), tagline, price, `Turnaround: <n> business days`, and feature list.
Requesting a package that does not exist returns a 404 rather than an error page.
